description: This file defines internal transport control structures and logic for gRPC's HTTP/2 transport layer, including control items, stream management, and a loopy writer for handling HTTP/2 frames and stream data.

classes.name: itemNode
classes.description: Node structure for linked list of control items.

classes.name: cleanupStream
classes.description: Represents stream cleanup info, including RST flag and code.

classes.name: dataFrame
classes.description: Represents a data frame to be sent or received on a stream.

classes.name: incomingWindowUpdate
classes.description: Represents an incoming window update for flow control.

classes.name: outgoingWindowUpdate
classes.description: Represents an outgoing window update for flow control.

classes.name: outFlowControlSizeRequest
classes.description: Request for current flow control window size.

classes.name: outStream
classes.description: Represents an HTTP/2 stream with its state and data queue.

classes.name: controlBuffer
classes.description: Buffer managing control frames and synchronization for transport.

classes.name: loopyWriter
classes.description: Handles processing of control frames and stream data, manages HTTP/2 frame writing.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds a control item to the item list.

methods.name: peek
methods.description: Returns the first item in the list without removing it.

methods.name: dequeue
methods.description: Removes and returns the first item in the list.

methods.name: dequeueAll
methods.description: Removes and returns all items from the list.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the list is empty.

methods.name: deleteSelf
methods.description: Removes the stream from its linked list.

methods.name: newOutStreamList
methods.description: Creates a new linked list for streams.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.description: Adds a stream to the active streams list.

methods.name: dequeue
methods.description: Removes and returns the first stream from the list.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main loop processing control frames and stream data, handles HTTP/2 frame writing.

methods.name: outgoingWindowUpdateHandler
methods.description: Handles outgoing window update frames.

methods.name: incomingWindowUpdateHandler
methods.description: Handles incoming window update frames, updates flow control windows.

methods.name: outgoingSettingsHandler
methods.description: Sends outgoing settings frames.

methods.name: incomingSettingsHandler
methods.description: Processes incoming settings frames and sends acknowledgment.

methods.name: registerStreamHandler
methods.description: Registers a new stream in the transport.

methods.name: headerHandler
methods.description: Handles header frames for streams.

methods.name: originateStream
methods.description: Creates and initiates a new stream.

methods.name: writeHeader
methods.description: Encodes and writes header frames.

methods.name: preprocessData
methods.description: Prepares data frames for sending, enqueues them into streams.

methods.name: pingHandler
methods.description: Handles ping frames.

methods.name: outFlowControlSizeRequestHandler
methods.description: Responds with current flow control window size.

methods.name: cleanupStreamHandler
methods.description: Cleans up stream resources, sends RST if needed.

methods.name: earlyAbortStreamHandler
methods.description: Handles early aborts of streams, sends headers and RST.

methods.name: incomingGoAwayHandler
methods.description: Handles incoming GOAWAY frames, initiates draining.

methods.name: goAwayHandler
methods.description: Handles outgoing GOAWAY frames, manages draining state.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Dispatches control items to appropriate handlers.

methods.name: applySettings
methods.description: Applies received HTTP/2 settings to the transport.

methods.name: processData
methods.description: Processes one stream's data, writes HTTP/2 data frames, manages flow control.
